title: Check Ignition Gateway system performance status via Ignition Gateway UI
summary: Use the Ignition Gateway web UI to open the system performance status page for sys.perf and confirm the page loads and displays system performance status content.
when_to_use: When you need to verify that the Ignition Gateway system performance status page is reachable and that it shows sys.perf system performance status content.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open the Ignition Gateway UI sys.perf status page and verify it loads and contains system performance status content; stop/escalate if unreachable or blank.
access_or_tools_needed: Web browser access to the Ignition Gateway host

access_required: Ignition Gateway UI access via web browser

visual_references.description: Ignition Gateway UI frame showing the sys.perf status URL path: http://localhost:8088/web/status/sys.perf

steps.title: Open the Ignition Gateway sys.perf system performance status page
steps.purpose: Establish reachability of the Ignition Gateway sys.perf status page.
steps.instruction: Using a web browser, navigate to http://localhost:8088/web/status/sys.perf.
steps.expected_result: The browser loads the Ignition Gateway sys.perf status page (i.e., not a browser error page).
steps.healthy_condition: The sys.perf page opens successfully in the browser.
steps.failure_condition: The page does not load (e.g., connection refused/timeout) or a browser error page appears.

actions.label: Navigate to sys.perf status URL
actions.exact_action: Open a web browser and navigate to http://localhost:8088/web/status/sys.perf.

stop_or_escalate_if: The sys.perf page is unreachable or fails to load (e.g., connection refused/timeout).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR text includes: “Ignition can be accessed through the web browser … http://localhost:8088/web/status/sys.perf …”

steps.title: Confirm the loaded page corresponds to sys.perf and is not blank
steps.purpose: Verify the correct sys.perf page content is present and usable for performance status interpretation.
steps.instruction: After the page loads, confirm the content corresponds to the sys.perf system performance status page and that the page shows system performance status information (not blank/failed content).
steps.expected_result: The sys.perf page displays system performance status information (visible performance/status content).
steps.healthy_condition: System performance/status content is visible on the sys.perf page.
steps.failure_condition: The page loads but shows no system performance/status content (blank/failed content) or does not correspond to sys.perf.

actions.label: Verify sys.perf content presence
actions.exact_action: Observe whether the page shows system performance status information rather than blank/failed content.

stop_or_escalate_if: The sys.perf page loads but shows no system performance/status content.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Source evidence provides the sys.perf URL path and indicates it is the Ignition Gateway performance page used to view performances.

success_criteria: http://localhost:8088/web/status/sys.perf loads successfully in the browser
The sys.perf page displays system performance status information (not blank/failed content)
healthy_conditions: Ignition Gateway sys.perf status page loads successfully and shows visible system performance/status content
failure_conditions: sys.perf page is unreachable or fails to load (connection refused/timeout)
sys.perf page loads but system performance/status content is missing/blank
escalation_guidance: If the sys.perf page is unreachable or fails to load, stop and escalate for Ignition gateway health investigation.
If the sys.perf page loads but shows no system performance/status content, stop and escalate.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: OCR text: “Ignition Gateway UI … Ignition can be accessed through the web browser … http://localhost:8088/web/status/sys.perf …”

missing_details: The source does not provide specific field names/values or exact visual indicators on the sys.perf page beyond that it is a system performance status/performance page; success is therefore limited to page load and presence of visible performance/status content.
